files.name: lib/Stay.svelte
files.contents:
A small guesthouse at Rua do Corvalinho 14 in Alfama. It is a 5-minute walk from the castle gate and on the Tram 28 line.

{#snippet actions()} (reserved = true)} /> ask('More places to stay in Lisbon for Nov 13–15, under €170 a night, central', 'More stays')} /> {/snippet}

files.name: lib/Saturday.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Action, MapView, List, ListRow, ask } from 'design';
  import Ticket from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/Ticket';
  import ForkKnife from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/ForkKnife';

  let booked = $state(false);
</script>

<Section title="Alfama and the castle" kicker="Saturday · Nov 14">
  <MapView
    height={220}
    places={[
      { label: 'Feira da Ladra', sublabel: 'Campo de Santa Clara' },
      { label: 'Castelo de São Jorge', sublabel: 'Castle hill' },
      { label: 'Senhora do Monte', sublabel: 'Viewpoint, Graça' },
      { label: 'Tasca Merendinha', sublabel: 'Fado dinner, Alfama' }
    ]}
  />
  <List>
    <ListRow index={1} label="Feira da Ladra flea market" sub="Runs Tuesdays and Saturdays" trailing="09:30" />
    <ListRow index={2} label="Castelo de São Jorge" sub="Walls and views over the river · €15" trailing="11:30" />
    <ListRow index={3} label="Lunch at Prato Saveiro" sub="Grilled sardines, Largo da Remeira 3" trailing="13:30" />
    <ListRow index={4} label="Tram 28 up to Graça" sub="Sunset at Miradouro da Senhora do Monte" trailing="16:30" />
    <ListRow index={5} label="Fado dinner at Tasca Merendinha" sub="Set menu, singers from 21:00 · €45" trailing="20:30" current={booked} />
  </List>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label={booked ? 'Table booked' : 'Book fado table'}
      sublabel={booked ? 'Sat 20:30 · 1 guest' : 'Sat 20:30 · only a few tables left'}
      icon={ForkKnife}
      primary
      disabled={booked}
      onclick={() => (booked = true)}
    />
    <Action
      label="Castle tickets"
      icon={Ticket}
      onclick={() => ask('Timed tickets for Castelo de São Jorge on Saturday Nov 14 around 11:30', 'Castle tickets')}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>

files.name: lib/Sunday.svelte
files.contents:
Check-out at Casa Vellumar is 11:00, so leave your bag at the desk before the tram.

{#snippet actions()} (saved = true)} /> ask('Flights to Lisbon arriving Fri Nov 13, returning Sun Nov 15 after 18:00', 'Find flights')} /> {/snippet}

files.contents: Flights not included. Other meals and coffee are extra.

<script>
  import { Section, Checklist } from 'design';
</script>

<Section title="What to pack" kicker="Mid-November · mild, chance of rain">
  <Checklist
    items={[
      'ID or passport',
      'Shoes with grip for the steep cobbles',
      'Light rain jacket',
      'Compact umbrella',
      'Warm layer for the evening viewpoint',
      'Phone charger and plug adapter'
    ]}
  />
</Section>
